// PRIVACY FOCUSED SEARCH ENGINES

> PRIVACY SEARCH ENGINES

MATCHING RECORDS: 6

  • Brave Search:
    Independent, privacy-first search engine built on its own web index rather than relying on Google or Bing.
  • Ecosia:
    Privacy-focused search engine that uses its ad revenue to plant trees.
  • Kagi:
    High-quality, ad-free, privacy-focused paid search engine offering custom result-ranking and domain-blocking.
  • Mojeek:
    Independent, privacy-conscious UK-based search engine operating its own crawler and index from scratch with strict zero-tracking policies.
  • Qwant:
    Privacy-respecting European search engine delivering zero-profiling web and news results.
  • Startpage:
    Privacy-focused search engine delivering Google search results with zero tracking, IP logging, or profiling by acting as an anonymizing proxy.
